name: Kohana
source:
A beastfolk sealed away by a wizard centuries ago, the one who summoned Mikuri and the protagonist to Yunagicho to break the seal. While sealed, she, as a "deity," had also called out to Mikuri.

Petite yet having a prominent bust, she often sticks out her chest to make herself look taller, which only ends up drawing attention to her large breasts.

Carefree, capricious, she always acts arrogant, yet beneath the façade lies a profound loneliness, perhaps born from the interminable, solitary centuries she spent prior to being sealed. Sometimes she will ask the protagonist, for no apparent reason, to rest her head on his lap.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/1241571]Getchu[/url]]
